overview: A Flutter-based mobile and desktop application that allows users to search for recipes using TheMealDB API, view recipe details, and discover new dishes through an intuitive interface.
target_audience: Home cooks looking for new recipes
Anyone interested in discovering new dishes

core_features.name: Recipe Search
core_features.description: Search for recipes by dish name using TheMealDB API
acceptance_criteria: User can enter recipe name in search bar
Results display recipe images, names, and basic info
Search works with partial names and common dishes

core_features.name: Recipe Categories
acceptance_criteria: Display popular recipe categories (Pizza, Burger, Pasta, etc.)
Tap category navigates to search results

core_features.name: Recipe Details
core_features.description: View detailed recipe information in WebView
acceptance_criteria: Tap recipe card opens detailed view
Works on both mobile and desktop platforms
Proper error handling for invalid URLs

core_features.name: Cross-Platform Support
acceptance_criteria: Runs on Android and iOS devices

ui_requirements.design_theme: Modern gradient design with dark theme
key_components: Recipe cards with images and labels
Responsive layout for different screen sizes
ui_requirements.color_scheme: Deep purple gradient background with white text
